title: International Higher National Diploma in Accounting and Business (Level 5)
description: Prepare for a rewarding career in accounting and business with advanced knowledge and skills tailored to dynamic organizational needs.
longDescription: The purpose of the International Higher National Diploma in Accounting and Business (Level 5) is to develop students professionally and individually self-reflecting who are able to satisfy the demands of the business sector and work in a constantly changing world around them. The International Higher National Diploma in Accounting and Business (Level 5) equips students with the expertise to excel in modern business environments. Through practical learning and theoretical insights, students will explore financial management, business strategy, and human resource practices. This program focuses on fostering entrepreneurial thinking and financial planning skills to support organizational success. Graduates will gain the ability to interpret financial data, develop strategic plans, and manage resources effectively. The course is designed for individuals aspiring to excel in accounting, finance, and business management roles. This International Higher National Diploma in Accounting and Business (Level 5) serves as a basis for your further business education and attracting employment opportunities. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: This programme delves into the development of business start-up plans, financial management, and planning frameworks essential for sustainability. Students will learn to prepare and analyze financial reports, evaluate business strategies, and align them with organizational goals. The curriculum also covers effective human resource management practices to foster talent and enhance workplace productivity. Graduates will emerge with the competencies to address contemporary business challenges and drive strategic growth. Successful completion of the full Level 5 Diploma in accounting and business will give students the right credentials to go on and apply for a job in marketing, accounting, human resources, management, or business consultancy.

entry: For entry into Level 5 International Higher National Diploma in Accounting and Business, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership, or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a Master degree programme from our partner University. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 60 credits which consist of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) University Progression Click here to see University routes and fee information for progression.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.

modules.title: Level 5 - Financial Management
modules.summary: Students develop skills in managing financial resources, focusing on capital budgeting, cost of capital, and financial decision-making.

modules.title: Level 5 - Business Start-up: Conception To Market
modules.summary: Students gain knowledge of the entrepreneurial process, from ideation and market analysis to developing a viable business plan and launching a start-up.

modules.title: Level 5 - Financial Planning And Control
modules.summary: This module covers techniques for financial forecasting, budgeting, and monitoring to ensure effective resource allocation and organizational control.

lessons.title: Introduction to Financial Planning and Control

modules.title: Level 5 - Financial Reporting
modules.summary: Students learn the principles and standards of financial reporting, focusing on preparing and interpreting financial statements for decision-making.

modules.title: Principles And Concepts Of Business Strategy
modules.summary: The "Principles and Concepts of Business Strategy" module explores the fundamental theories, frameworks, and practices that guide organizations in formulating and executing effective strategies to achieve long-term business success and competitive advantage.

modules.title: Level 5 - The Management Of Human Resources
modules.summary: This module examines HR practices, including recruitment, training, and employee engagement, to support organizational effectiveness.

lessons.title: The Evolution of Human Resource Management

outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to develop and evaluate a comprehensive business start-up plan, from ideation to market launch, incorporating market research, financial projections, and strategic positioning.
Analyze and apply key principles of financial management to make informed decisions that enhance organizational financial health and sustainability.
Develop and implement effective financial planning and control mechanisms to monitor budgets, manage costs, and ensure the achievement of business objectives.
Interpret and present financial reports to support strategic decision-making while ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards.
Critically evaluate business strategy principles and concepts to formulate and implement competitive strategies that align with organizational goals and market dynamics.
Assess and apply human resource management practices to attract, develop, and retain talent while fostering a productive and inclusive workplace.
